academic.passage: The study of electromagnetism is crucial for modern physics. It explores the interaction between electric charges and magnetic fields, which is fundamental in various technologies. Applications range from electric motors to wireless communication systems, highlighting its importance in engineering and daily life. By understanding these principles, scientists can innovate and improve existing technologies, making electromagnetism a vital area of research in contemporary science.
